title: Rust production DIO admission lets peers self-assert root role
description: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs derives ExpectedDioRole from the received DIO's own rank, and codec validation merely confirms that self-derived role. AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext binds source IID to signer but does not require a root-rank DODAGID to equal AddrForKey(root signer). Any authenticated non-root peer can claim rank 256 for the configured DODAG and pass admission. Supply trusted expected role/root identity from local DODAG policy, enforce key-derived DODAG root binding, consume root_authorization.json in Rust, and add peer-root impersonation/rekey tests.
